statements: 1 Provisioning Robust and Efficient LiDAR Perception for Autonomous Driving Tingxu Han∗ , Zijie Shen∗ , An Guo, Lyuke Wang, Chunrong Fang, Zhenyu Chen, and Wei Song arXiv:2610.27617v1 [cs.CV] 20 Oct 2026 ✦ Abstract-LiDAR-based 3D object detection is a core perception service for autonomous driving, yet practical deployment requires maintaining robustness to point-cloud corruption while meeting
Existing approaches typically address robustness and resource efficiency separately, resulting in compact detectors that are fragile under corruption or robust detectors that remain costly to deploy.
We therefore formulate LiDAR perception provisioning as constructing a detector that remains accurate under point-cloud corruptions while meeting constraints on inference latency and peak GPU memory.
